profile.name: Janak Devkota
profile.headline: Full-Stack Engineer
profile.tagline: Building AI-native platforms, IoT systems and production APIs end to end.
profile.bio: Full-stack engineer from Pokhara, Nepal. I build production systems across web, mobile, desktop and IoT — from Next.js interfaces to FastAPI, Django and Spring Boot backends, message queues and containerized infrastructure. Currently engineering the Voids platform at Everest Technologies and leading ChargeGhar at Devalaya Infosys.
profile.education: BSc (Hons) in Computing — Informatics College Pokhara (Expected Jun 2026)
profile.coursework: Web Development, Software Design, Database Management, Object-Oriented Programming, Algorithms and Data Structures
profile.interests: State-level badminton competitor; also chess, cricket and table tennis.

points: Engineering the Voids platform, a real-world parking and access management system serving production traffic with high availability requirements
Building responsive frontend interfaces with Next.js and TypeScript while architecting backend RESTful APIs using FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy
Designing and optimizing PostgreSQL database schemas with Alembic migrations, and leveraging Redis for high-performance caching and session management
Implementing microservices architecture with RabbitMQ for asynchronous communication, event-driven design, and background worker queues
Securing service-to-service communication with mTLS and deploying containerized services via Docker to NorthFlank cloud infrastructure
Collaborating in an Agile environment with sprint planning, daily standups, Linear issue tracking, and GitHub PR-based peer code reviews
Led full-stack development of ChargeGhar, an enterprise IoT platform for managing connected power bank charging stations at scale
Architected scalable backend systems using Django and Spring Boot with Next.js frontend, ensuring robust API design and efficient real-time data processing
Integrated EMQX MQTT broker, Redis caching, and RabbitMQ messaging to handle high-throughput device telemetry and command dispatch
Containerized development and production environments with Docker, optimizing database queries and backend logic to enhance system efficiency
Developed responsive frontend dashboards for real-time device monitoring, remote control, and fleet management with intuitive UX
Delivered projects on schedule while maintaining high code quality standards through cross-functional collaboration and rigorous testing

projects.title: ForgeKit
projects.description: Open-source Android plugin runtime built around a real Termux Linux environment, with native tools, persistent jobs and a full terminal.
points: Embeds a SHA-256-verified Termux runtime to run Linux packages, Python, Node and native binaries on Android.
Imports signed .forge plugin packages with manifest validation, dependency provisioning and declarative native Compose interfaces.
Runs plugin actions as persisted jobs with live logs, progress and cancellation; includes an interactive PTY terminal with ANSI color support.

projects.title: DNSHero
projects.description: Open-source cross-platform DNS security manager with system tray integration for Linux, macOS and Windows.
points: Tauri v2 (Rust) backend with React 19 frontend, real-time latency monitoring with live charts, one-click provider switching and full activity history with rollback
Platform-specific DNS abstractions (resolvectl, netsh, networksetup) with secure privilege elevation via Polkit/UAC/macOS auth
Dual-theme glass-card UI (Void/Quartz) with Cloudflare, Google, OpenDNS, Quad9 and custom providers; shipped .deb, .AppImage, .msi and .dmg releases

projects.title: Katha
projects.description: Nepal's AI-powered audio streaming platform for podcasts, audiobooks and storytelling, serving 1000+ active listeners.
points: Multi-provider AI pipeline: OpenRouter for LLM orchestration, ElevenLabs for neural voices and Replicate for thumbnails
Creator monetization with premium streaming, per-minute earnings tracking and AI-driven recommendations
Deployed on Vercel with Redis caching, MySQL persistence and Docker for low-latency audio

projects.title: RevArt Suite
projects.description: Three production AI art generation platforms (RevArt Max, v2, v3), each tuned for a distinct creative workflow.
points: From professional artwork to rapid creative sketches across three variants
Multiple AI image APIs with diverse styles, high-resolution output and responsive design

projects.description: Automated AI video composition and image-to-video tools for content creators.

projects.title: RevChatBot
projects.description: Unified multi-LLM chat platform for GPT, Claude and Gemini in one interface.
points: Real-time chat with conversation history, model comparison and context-aware threading

projects.title: IpoMitra
projects.description: Cross-platform app for MeroShare family IPO portfolio tracking with real-time sync.
points: React Native/Expo frontend with FastAPI + Socket.IO backend, MongoDB (Beanie) and Redis
APScheduler jobs for IPO sync, reconciliation and cleanup; Dockerized on VPS behind Nginx
Google OAuth 2.0, Cloudinary media and WebSocket-driven live updates with rate limiting

projects.description: Enterprise IoT platform for secure management of connected power bank stations with real-time monitoring and control.
points: Spring Boot IoT server for device connections, telemetry and secure management over MQTT
Django backend for auth, REST integrations and user-to-hardware communication
React dashboard for device health, charging sessions and fleet management
